facts.text: Grimny's ghost believes his greedy brother Bral killed him; the party concludes Bral is the dwarf they lost a gambling bet to and got their treasure map from. Did Bral really murder Grimny?

Dunk wears the magical ring from the dead dwarf's finger, which let him see and speak with Grimny's ghost; Dr. Uriah could not tell whether it is cursed, and Dunk felt a growing urge to put it on. Is the ring cursed?
